headline: Can Target (TGT) Still Be A Bargain As Recovery Gets Tested?
summary: Target has delivered a strong 50.2% share price return over the past year, yet its valuation signals are split. The Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate points to a premium, while earnings-based multiples suggest the stock may still be pricing in some value. Over the past 1 year, Target has returned 50.2%, which puts the recent rally front and center for anyone thinking about valuation today.
